description: Read exact durable template preparation status. For library-import or library-export, ready means a saved organization template and destination-owned package receipt; projectId remains null. Preserve templateId/templateVersion, documentSha256 and package receipt; refresh its URL with get_template_package_download. Export sourceProjectId identifies the original saved project; projectId remains null. For ordinary instantiation/apply, read the returned projectId. Failed/cancelled states include the retained reason. Do not treat preparing as successful import.
name: get_template_job
title: Get Template Job
